Method of Attack: Encrypts victim's files and appends .PLANETARY extension
Accepts ransom payments in Bitcoin, Monero, and Ethereum
Manually installed by developer after hacking into networks using remote desktop
Allows victim to decrypt a single machine or entire network for ransom
Previously decryptable by memory forensics if computer not rebooted
Impacted Systems: Windows machines accessed via remote desktop on compromised networks
Attack Vector: Developer hacking into networks using remote desktop protocol (RDP)
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom note demanding $700 per machine or $5,000 for entire network
Ransom note includes BTC, Monero (XMR), and Ethereum payment addresses
